newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Further Portugal Telecom sell-off may slip.
newsitem.headline: Further Portugal Telecom sell-off may slip.

text.p: The government would like to complete the third phase of the privatisation of Portugal Telecom by the beginning of October but it may not be possible, deputy finance minister Fernando Teixeira dos Santos said.

Teixeira dos Santos, who leads the privatisation team, said that competition from other international privatisations and the fact that a draft law allowing the state to drop below 50 percent in the sector was still before parliament could force a delay.
"I am not sure it is going to be possible," he said, referring to the planned privatisation timetable.
The general outline of the telecommunications law has been approved but it still needs to be given the green light by a special legislative committee, Dos Santos noted.
The government controls 51 percent of Portugal Telecom and wants to shed around half of this stake in the next phase.
